notes.title: Patch!
notes.content:
Updates:
[list]
[*]Now you can play "Code World" with any keyboard layout
[*]When you copy some text in the game's code editor (Ctrl + C, Ctrl + X), it goes to the OS clipboard. Also you can copy some text anywhere outside the game and paste it (Ctrl + V) in code editor of the game.
[*]File "list_of_functions.txt" contains the "help" section content. You can find this file in the root folder of the game and even print it if you want.
[/list]
If something in the game doesn't work properly on your PC, please tell me in the discussions!

tags.feature: Now you can play "Code World" with any keyboard layout

When you copy some text in the game's code editor (Ctrl + C, Ctrl + X), it goes to the OS clipboard. Also you can copy some text anywhere outside the game and paste it (Ctrl + V) in code editor of the game.
File "list_of_functions.txt" contains the "help" section content. You can find this file in the root folder of the game and even print it if you want.
